title: NASA announcement of Planet X / Planet 10
summary: Matt LaCroix tells of NASA announcement of Planet X / Planet 10, about 1990s at Outer solar system, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: announcement by NASA and I do believe this was a real announcement where they did announce this planet and they called it Planet n or Planet 10

plain: Matt LaCroix, a writer on ancient history, says that NASA, the US space agency, once made an announcement about an unknown planet in the far outer solar system. He believes it was a real announcement and says they called it Planet X or Planet 10. If true, it would mean a large hidden world sits beyond the known planets, which some link to stories about ancient catastrophes.
